+package jdk.internal.misc;
+
+/**
+ * A carrier thread, other than {@link CarrierThread}, whose scheduler keeps a
+ * {@link Blocker} section from blocking it: the MPSC scheduler moves the section's
+ * virtual thread to a thread of its offload pool.
+ */
+public interface BlockingCarrier {
+    /**
+     * Invoked by the virtual thread mounted on this carrier before it blocks.
+     * @return true if {@link #endBlocking()} must be invoked after the operation
+     */
+    boolean beginBlocking();
+
+    /**
+     * Invoked by a virtual thread after a blocking operation whose
+     * {@link #beginBlocking()} returned true, on the carrier it is mounted on then,
+     * which need not be the one it began on.
+     */
+    void endBlocking();
+}

+/*
+ * For FileDescriptor.fsClassify: java_io_FileDescriptor_FS_LOCAL if fd is a regular
+ * file on a local filesystem, else java_io_FileDescriptor_FS_OTHER (also when fstat or
+ * fstatfs fails). On Linux the filesystem type must be on an allow-list: a type missing
+ * from it is treated as other, which costs a hand-off per synchronous operation, never
+ * a carrier held by a remote wait. On macOS and the BSDs it is MNT_LOCAL. Elsewhere
+ * every file is other.
+ */
+#if defined(__linux__)
+// Inlined from <linux/magic.h> for portability.
+#define MAGIC_EXT4       0xEF53       /* ext2, ext3, ext4 */
+#define MAGIC_XFS        0x58465342
+#define MAGIC_BTRFS      0x9123683E
+#define MAGIC_F2FS       0xF2F52010
+#define MAGIC_BCACHEFS   0xca451a4e
+#define MAGIC_TMPFS      0x01021994
+#define MAGIC_RAMFS      0x858458f6
+#define MAGIC_HUGETLBFS  0x958458f6
+#define MAGIC_OVERLAYFS  0x794c7630
+#define MAGIC_MSDOS      0x4d44       /* vfat */
+#define MAGIC_EXFAT      0x2011BAB0
+// From OpenZFS include/sys/fs/zfs.h (ZFS_SUPER_MAGIC).
+#define MAGIC_ZFS        0x2fc12fc1
+#endif
+
+#if defined(__linux__) || defined(_ALLBSD_SOURCE)
+static int isLocalFs(const struct statfs *st) {
+#if defined(__linux__)
+    switch ((unsigned int) st->f_type) {
+    case MAGIC_EXT4:
+    case MAGIC_XFS:
+    case MAGIC_BTRFS:
+    case MAGIC_F2FS:
+    case MAGIC_BCACHEFS:
+    case MAGIC_TMPFS:
+    case MAGIC_RAMFS:
+    case MAGIC_HUGETLBFS:
+    case MAGIC_OVERLAYFS:
+    case MAGIC_MSDOS:
+    case MAGIC_EXFAT:
+    case MAGIC_ZFS:
+        return 1;
+    default:
+        return 0;
+    }
+#else
+    return (st->f_flags & MNT_LOCAL) != 0;
+#endif
+}
+#endif
+
+JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
+Java_java_io_FileDescriptor_fsKind0(JNIEnv *env, jclass fdClass, jint fd) {
+#if defined(__linux__) || defined(_ALLBSD_SOURCE)
+    struct statfs st;
+    struct stat sb;
+    int r;
+    // fstatfs first: on a remote filesystem fstat is itself a request to the server
+    RESTARTABLE(fstatfs(fd, &st), r);
+    if (r != 0 || !isLocalFs(&st)) {
+        return java_io_FileDescriptor_FS_OTHER;
+    }
+    RESTARTABLE(fstat(fd, &sb), r);
+    if (r != 0 || !S_ISREG(sb.st_mode)) {
+        return java_io_FileDescriptor_FS_OTHER;
+    }
+    return java_io_FileDescriptor_FS_LOCAL;
+#else
+    return java_io_FileDescriptor_FS_OTHER;
+#endif
+}
+

+/*
+ * @test id=default
+ * @summary MPSC scheduler: an idle carrier runs a thread queued on a busy carrier
+ * @requires vm.continuations
+ * @library /test/lib
+ * @run junit/othervm -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.useMpsc=true
+ *                    -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.parallelism=2 MpscStealTest
+ */
+
+/*
+ * @test id=mode2
+ * @requires vm.continuations & os.family == "linux"
+ * @library /test/lib
+ * @run junit/othervm -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.useMpsc=true -Djdk.pollerMode=2
+ *                    -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.parallelism=2 MpscStealTest
+ */
+
+/*
+ * @test id=nosteal
+ * @requires vm.continuations
+ * @library /test/lib
+ * @run junit/othervm -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.useMpsc=true
+ *                    -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.mpscSteal=false
+ *                    -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.parallelism=2 MpscStealTest
+ */
+
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
+import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
+
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue;
+
+class MpscStealTest {
+
+    /**
+     * The started thread is queued on the starter's carrier, and the starter spins without
+     * unmounting until it has run, so only another carrier can run it.
+     */
+    @Test
+    void testIdleCarrierTakesAQueuedThread() throws Exception {
+        assumeTrue(MpscTestSupport.STEAL, "stealing is off");
+        for (int round = 0; round < 10; round++) {
+            AtomicBoolean ran = new AtomicBoolean();
+            AtomicBoolean seenWhileSpinning = new AtomicBoolean();
+            Thread spinner = Thread.ofVirtual().start(() -> {
+                Thread.ofVirtual().start(() -> ran.set(true));
+                long end = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(MpscTestSupport.DEADLINE_MS);
+                while (!ran.get() && System.nanoTime() - end < 0) {
+                    Thread.onSpinWait();
+                }
+                seenWhileSpinning.set(ran.get());
+            });
+            spinner.join();
+            assertTrue(seenWhileSpinning.get(), "round " + round
+                    + ": the queued thread did not run while its carrier was busy");
+        }
+    }
+}

+/*
+ * @test
+ * @summary MPSC scheduler's queue: with concurrent producers, owner and thieves, every element
+ *          is taken once and each consumer takes each producer's elements in offer order
+ * @library /test/lib
+ * @compile/module=java.base java/lang/RunQueueConcurrency.java
+ * @run junit/othervm RunQueueTest
+ */
+
+import java.lang.RunQueueConcurrency;
+
+import jdk.test.lib.Utils;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class RunQueueTest {
+    private static final long TIMEOUT_MS = Utils.adjustTimeout(60_000);
+
+    @ParameterizedTest
+    @CsvSource({
+        // initialCapacity, maxChunkCapacity, producers, perProducer, thieves
+        "2, 2, 4, 20000, 2",
+        "2, 64, 4, 50000, 3",
+        "64, 1073741824, 4, 50000, 3",
+        "64, 1073741824, 1, 100000, 1",
+    })
+    void testConcurrentProducersAndConsumers(int initialCapacity, int maxChunkCapacity,
+                                             int producers, int perProducer, int thieves)
+            throws Exception {
+        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
+            int run = i;
+            String failure = RunQueueConcurrency.run(initialCapacity, maxChunkCapacity,
+                    producers, perProducer, thieves, TIMEOUT_MS);
+            assertNull(failure, () -> "run " + run + ": " + failure);
+        }
+    }
+}
